subject.title: [Feature]: Session busy status reply + cancel option during long-running model responses

question: Should OpenClaw add a generic busy-session acknowledgement by default, make it opt-in/configurable, and which portable cancel/new-session actions and busy reason fields should be part of the contract?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes cross-channel UX, default chat noise, configuration expectations, and command/action semantics.

options.title: Conservative default
options.body: Add a short default busy acknowledgement with no destructive action by default, plus typed optional cancel/new-session actions where channels can render them safely.

options.title: Opt-in configuration
options.body: Add the same core contract behind explicit messages.queue configuration so existing deployments preserve silent enqueue behavior unless operators enable it.

options.title: Channel-local implementations
options.body: Leave core queue behavior unchanged and ask channel or plugin owners to implement local busy UX, accepting inconsistent behavior across surfaces.

recommendation.title: Conservative default
recommendation.body: Add a short default busy acknowledgement with no destructive action by default, plus typed optional cancel/new-session actions where channels can render them safely.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history on the queue policy and queued-followup behavior that this product decision would change.
